description: Capture any public web page as one full-page PNG, 1280 px wide, after it loads and scrolls to the bottom. Returns a stored image link plus the final page URL. Use it when: An agent needs to see a page as a person does: a visual check, a record of how a page looked, a design review or input for an image model. Not for: Pages behind a login, or reading the text (use url-to-markdown, which is cheaper and gives text). Returns: One full-page PNG link (stored permanently) and the page URL after redirects. Typical time: about 35 s. Price: $0.008 per screenshot, charged only on success. One call = one full-page screenshot (PNG).

url.description: The page to capture, e.g. https://tollnode.com
